hooks.name: Review builder handoff

action.prompt: A builder handoff report was just saved. Follow the review protocol in #review exactly. Read the matching brief in docs/briefs/, the report, and every file the report lists. Re-run the Definition of Done commands where possible instead of trusting the report. Write the result to docs/reviews/<TNN>-review.md, using the same TNN as the report. Do not edit any code during the review.

hooks.description: Kiro reviews Antigravity's work when a handoff report is saved
